title: Design: the switch-location dialog frame matches the design pictures
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The organization has open documents in these reports at two locations, {Location-A} and {Location-B}, and you are enrolled at both; {Location-A}'s name comes first in A to Z order.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 and {Location-B} is Staging Lethbridge - 4310.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has an open work order invoice {Invoice-A} made at {Location-B}.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST D-64 Dialog Frame.
  • Starting screen: A/R Detail (Reports, then "A/R Aging Detail" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu) is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu in light theme at 100% zoom, with {Customer-A} ticked and every bucket expanded.
  • The design pictures "Another location asks first" (ar-ap-p5-another-location-asks-first.png) and "Cancel stays on the report" (ar-ap-p5-cancel-stays-on-the-report.png) are attached to this case and open beside the browser at 100% zoom; compare the layout, labels and styles, not the names and amounts, which are only examples.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the dialog opens over the report: as in the first picture, a white dialog in the middle of the window, with the report dimmed behind it; read letter for letter: the bold title "Switch location?", then "This work order is in ", {Location-B}'s name and "Switch your active location to view it?"; then "Cancel" on the left and "Switch location" (small l) on the right, and a close "×" at the top right, as in the picture except that the picture writes "Switch Location" with a capital L (the PRD's small l is right: see References from Design).
  • Step 2: the dialog closes, and the report is exactly as before the click, as in the second picture: the same filters, open bucket, sort and scroll position.

Where the build is expected to differ: Chris Ward (answer 11, 23 Oct 2026) says the current build writes the button "Switch Location" with a capital L, a build bug to fix; the PRD's "Switch location" stands. No ticket number is known yet. If the button reads "Switch Location", mark this test Failed.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11537 (Story 7, Document links open where they can)

  • S7-R3: “An invoice or part sale at another location the user is enrolled in shows the existing location-switch prompt on the report, before leaving it: title "Switch location?", message "This work order is in {location}. Switch your active location to view it?" (for a part sale: "This part sale is in {location}. Switch your active location to view it?"), buttons "Cancel" on the left and "Switch location" on the right, and a close × at the top right.”
  • S7-R5: “"Cancel" or the × closes the prompt; the user stays on the report exactly where they were: same page address, filters, sort, expanded groups and scroll position.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Click an invoice at another enrolled location | Title "Switch location?", message "This work order is in {location}. Switch your active location to view it?" | Dialog on the report; "Switch location" switches and opens, "Cancel" stays”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "A/R and A/P Report Sorting" (https://claude.ai/artifact/BRYCdjKwGRSgGPC9xxkgF4), read 22 Oct 2026: page 5 "Document links and Switch location" (board Links.dc.html). Compare the screen with the pictures below at 100% zoom; the expected results still come from the PRD quotes above, the pictures give the look and the on-screen labels.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • ar-ap-p5-another-location-asks-first.png: figure "Another location asks first" (This build (after)), board "5. Document links and Switch location (SV-5706)"
  • ar-ap-p5-cancel-stays-on-the-report.png: figure "Cancel stays on the report" (This build (after)), board "5. Document links and Switch location (SV-5706)"

The design's own words:

  • ""Switch location? This work order is in Staging Lethbridge - 4310. Switch your active location to view it?" on the report. Switch Location opens it there. S7-R3, S7-R4." (caption of "Another location asks first")
  • "Same filters, open groups and scroll position. S7-R5, S7-E1." (caption of "Cancel stays on the report")

Difference from the PRD (DD-01), closed: PRD version 5 said buttons "Switch location" and "Cancel" (S7-R3), title "Switch location?"; the design shows buttons "Cancel" (left, grey) then "Switch Location" (right, blue, capital L), and a close "×" at the top right of the dialog; caption: "Switch Location opens it there.". Chris Ward ruled on 23 Oct 2026 (answer 11): the existing prompt keeps "Cancel" on the left, "Switch location" (small l) on the right and a close × at the top right, and the × closes it like Cancel; the capital L the picture and the current build show is a build bug to fix. PRD version 9 (S7-R3, S7-R5) now says so, and this case follows PRD version 9. The held design-version case D-76 (C715558) was deleted from TestRail on 26 Oct 2026 with the QA lead's go-ahead (snapshot in v9-pass-2026-10-26/deleted/).
